description: Breach walls: side-lane trials (Stage 2, 3) and the large Stage 1 barrel lesson (gate: closes the way on until broken; the route flows count it open; panels: intact panels at these multiples of the wall width along local +X, pacing-pressure-plan.md 4.4). at/barrel are [x,y,z] metres; yaw is 0 or 90 degrees. Each barrel is a real explosive barrel. plain_panel adds one intact matching panel along the wall's local +X. All routes remain usable before destruction.
